thread:
Maya (AE): Hey team — kicking off the POC with Stargazer. Quick sync: they want a 2-week technical POC starting next Mon. Main asks: latency < 300ms tail p95, semantic search accuracy >= 78% on their eval set, and cost target ~40% of current vendor.
Carlos (SE): Got it. I pushed their dataset sample and prompt archetypes to the shared drive. I can own infra and prompt tuning.
Tariq (Eng): I'll scope required Dedicated config. Likely need 2xA10G-equivalent for stable throughput. Any hard constraints on VPC or data residency?
Maya (AE): They need EU data residency and SOC2 controls. Also they asked about offline on-prem eval later.
Jess (Security): We'll need them to fill the standard security questionnaire (SSQ v3). I'll start the high-risk review in parallel. Heads-up: they'll ask about KMS integration and audit logs.
Sam (CS): I'll coordinate stakeholder access and arrange a demo app they can hit. Can we keep Canary traffic to the hosted tier for the POC?
Carlos (SE): Yes — plan: hosted Redwood API for quick start, fallback to Dedicated pool if latency spikes. Config notes: prefix caching enabled, batching threshold 8, and quantized model variant for cost.
Maya (AE): Agenda for kick-off call (30m): 1) Introductions (5m) 2) Use-case walkthrough + success criteria (10m) 3) Data & security checklist (5m) 4) Timeline & next steps (5m) 5) Blockers/questions (5m). Agree?
Tariq (Eng): Agree. For success criteria we should capture concrete evals: a) end-to-end p95 latency <300ms at 20req/s b) MRR uplift simulation: relevance NDCG@10 > baseline by 0.12 c) inference cost per 1k requests < $X (we'll estimate).
Carlos (SE): Adding prompt/eval samples — here's a quick one they want tested: ```
# Prompt archetype
System: You are a concise product search assistant.
User: "Find ergonomic office chairs under $300 with lumbar support."
Evaluate: Is the top result relevant? (yes/no)
```
Maya (AE): Timeline proposal: Week 0 (kickoff + SSQ + dataset ingest), Week 1 (baseline runs, tuning), Week 2 (final eval + wrap). Need stakeholder commitment: Product owner, Data owner, Security reviewer.
Jess (Security): I'll need their data flow diagram and the SSQ returned by Day 2. Also confirm no PHI.
Sam (CS): I'll request the PO and Data Owner on the invite.
Maya (AE): Blockers callout: 1) Legal needs DPAs signed for EU residency — sales to confirm timeline. 2) If they require on-prem, that extends to 6-8 weeks. 3) Pricing questions: They asked about committed vs burst pricing — Sam, can you prep rough numbers?
Sam (CS): Yes — I'll attach a delta table with Dedicated commit options and a short-hosted surcharge for burst.
Carlos (SE): Operational checklist for POC: API keys scoped to the trial project, model pin to v1.3-q4, enable prefix cache, set request quotas, enable trace headers. I'll drop the commands in the shared doc.
calendar-bot: Meeting created: "Stargazer POC Kickoff" Mon 09:00 CET, 30m. Invite sent to client PO + Data Owner + our crew.
Maya (AE): Perfect. Action items: Maya — confirm contract/DPA timeline (due EOD Fri). Carlos — infra runbook + eval harness (due Mon morning). Jess — SSQ kickoff (due Tue). Sam — pricing delta and invite attendees (due EOD today).
Tariq (Eng): One more Q: Any non-functional requirement for throughput? If they hit 50qps we need autoscale plan.
Maya (AE): They said typical peak 25qps, burst up to 50qps for 2-3 minutes. We'll plan autoscale but cap costs.
Carlos (SE): Noted. I'll include autoscale policy in the runbook.
Maya (AE): Thanks team — will post the kickoff notes and the shared drive links here after the call. :rocket:
Sam (CS): Thanks! I'll follow up with pricing doc and roster. :thumbsup:
